available.quote: Electrical contractors who hold an electrical contractor or master electrician occupational or business license issued by any political subdivision in this state shall be eligible for a statewide license

requirements.value: Holders of a local electrical contractor or master electrician license must: provide evidence of passing a standardized written electrical assessment examination based on the NEC administered by an independent testing agency; provide evidence of 12,000 hours of verifiable practical experience or having been licensed by any Missouri political subdivision requiring examination as an electrical contractor or master electrician for 6 of the previous 8 calendar years; provide proof of insurance; and proof that the local license was current, active, and not subject to discipline.
requirements.quote: Electrical contractors who hold an electrical contractor or master electrician occupational or business license issued by any political subdivision in this state shall be eligible for a statewide license if the applicant: (1) Provides evidence of having passed a standardized written electrical assessment examination that is based upon the National Electrical Code and administered by an independent competent professional testing agency not affiliated with a political subdivision or the state of Missouri

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication or guilty plea for a criminal offense directly related to the duties and responsibilities of the occupation.
